passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.text: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

spells.name: Threaded Volley
spells.text: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

spells.name: Seismic Shove
spells.text: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

spells.name: Unraveled Earth
spells.text: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

spells.name: Weaver's Wall
spells.text: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

axis.value: Taliyah thins waves early, plays defensively when needed, and looks for E poke while scaling.

winCondition.value: Taliyah uses her area damage and disruption to control fights in narrow spaces.

spikes.why: Taliyah's Threaded Volley cooldown falls from 7 to 3, letting her cast it more often.

bait.why: Taliyah cannot create Unraveled Earth's slowing minefield while it is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Taliyah risks committing too early when threatening abilities have not been used.
